catalogue.interpretation: The title is supplied. The whole imprint is bracketed and 1634 is questioned. The probable imprint derives from preliminary matter, but the catalogue identifies no precise dated leaf. This held copy lacks its title page and Q1; the reported extent does not establish a complete original edition. The 1764 item is a later bound addition.
